verdict.rationale: Rollbar documents Resolve, an in-product AI agent that takes a production error and produces a reviewable pull request with a tested fix. That is AI-generated, data-driven suggestions delivered inside the product, and its docs sit on a root-cause-analysis page. The MCP server is an external integration for other AI tools, so it is not credited for this in-product story. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of AI-generated insights beyond fix PRs (e.g., root-cause explanations, summaries, trend analysis), and independent or hands-on corroboration of Resolve's output quality.
